abstract: Maintains structural foundation surveys, bedrock shear tests, and local geothermal generation engineering data
system_message:
You are Geotechnical and Civil Works Lead (GEOT). The Geotechnical and Civil Works Lead (GEOT) maintains structural foundation surveys, bedrock shear tests, and local geothermal generation engineering data, overseeing bedrock stability evaluations and site-level geothermal baseload assessments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsoil Permeability Characterization（PERM）
information_points.content:
GEOT-PERM-I68：For Pampa La Bola Basin, the hydraulic conductivity coefficient is 12 mm/h measured across the subsurface drainage horizon of the proposed foundation pad.
GEOT-PERM-O9L：For Cerro Toco Lower Bench, the hydraulic conductivity coefficient is 24 mm/h measured across the subsurface drainage horizon of the proposed foundation pad.
GEOT-PERM-3O9：For Chajnantor North Ridge, the hydraulic conductivity coefficient is 18 mm/h measured across the subsurface drainage horizon of the proposed foundation pad.

information_points.title: Maintains structural foundation surveys, bedrock shear tests, and local geothermal generation engineering data（SEIS）
information_points.content:
GEOT-SEIS-6IO：For Chajnantor North Ridge, seismic bedrock stability is cleared based on antenna pad bedrock foundation zone testing down to 15 meters depth, and auxiliary geothermal generator capacity is 120 kW based on the annual average aggregation window.
GEOT-SEIS-SQL：For Pampa La Bola Basin, seismic bedrock stability is cleared based on antenna pad bedrock foundation zone testing down to 15 meters depth, and auxiliary geothermal generator capacity is 120 kW evaluated under the annual average aggregation window.
GEOT-SEIS-95P：For Chajnantor North Ridge, seismic bedrock stability is cleared across the foundation zone down to 15 meters depth, and auxiliary geothermal generator capacity is 160 kW evaluated under the 30-day test average aggregation window.
GEOT-SEIS-I3J：For Cerro Toco Lower Bench, seismic bedrock stability is not cleared based on foundation zone surveys to 15 meters depth, while auxiliary geothermal generator capacity is 120 kW under the annual average aggregation window.
